desc.zh: 天是蓝的，落日是红的，云是白的，火星的天是黄褐的。九个可以拖动的模型：光子穿过空气、1/λ⁴、天空光的光谱、眼睛为什么不认紫、落日、整片天空、从分子到云滴的颗粒、火星的天空，以及多次散射和臭氧。
desc.en: The sky is blue, sunsets are red, clouds are white and the Martian sky is butterscotch. Nine models you can push: photons crossing the air, 1/λ⁴, the skylight spectrum, why the eye doesn't see violet, sunset, the whole sky, particles from molecules to cloud drops, the sky of Mars, and multiple scattering and ozone.

title.zh: 天空光是被空气拐弯的阳光
title.en: Skylight is sunlight scattered by air

desc.zh: 天空本身不发光；整层空气拐走约 20% 的蓝光、约 5% 的红光，落到地面的那一半就是天空的光。
desc.en: The sky gives off no light of its own: the whole air column scatters about 20% of blue light and 5% of red, and the half that comes down is the skylight.

zh: 月球上的天为什么是黑的
为什么从太空看地球边缘是蓝的
en: why is the sky black on the moon
blue edge of the earth from space

desc.zh: 比光波小得多的粒子里，电子被光推着晃，发出的光强与频率的四次方成正比，所以 450 纳米蓝光的散射约是 700 纳米红光的 6 倍。
desc.en: In a particle far smaller than the wavelength, light shakes the electrons and they re-radiate with power rising as frequency to the fourth, so 450 nm blue scatters about 6× more than 700 nm red.

en: why does blue light scatter more

title.zh: 天空光的光谱峰在紫外
title.en: The skylight spectrum peaks in the ultraviolet

desc.zh: 把黑体阳光的光谱乘上 1/λ⁴，模型里的最强处从约 500 纳米挪到紫外（真实阳光的紫外到地面前已被臭氧吸收）；可见范围内，紫光段的能量多于蓝光段。
desc.en: Multiply a blackbody solar spectrum by 1/λ⁴ and in the model its peak moves from about 500 nm into the ultraviolet (real ultraviolet is absorbed by ozone before reaching the ground); in the visible range violet carries more energy than blue.

title.zh: 为什么天不是紫的：眼睛的三种视锥
title.en: Why the sky isn't violet: the eye's three cones

desc.zh: 眼睛只报告三种视锥各被激发多少；紫光段带来 44% 的能量却只贡献约 1% 的亮度，整片光谱读出来是掺了白的蓝（主波长 476 纳米）。
desc.en: The eye reports only how much each of three cone types is excited; violet brings 44% of the energy but about 1% of the brightness, and the whole spectrum reads as a whitish blue (dominant wavelength 476 nm).

zh: 为什么天空不是紫色的
en: why is the sky not violet

title.zh: 落日为什么是红的：大气质量
title.en: Why sunsets are red: air mass

desc.zh: 太阳越低，光在空气里走的路越长（贴着地平线约 38 倍），蓝光被拐走得最多，剩下橙红。
desc.en: The lower the sun, the longer the path through air (about 38× at the horizon); blue is removed first and orange-red is left.

title.en: Deepest blue overhead, white at the horizon

desc.zh: 看向地平线时视线很长，拐进来的蓝光又在半路被拐走，颜色趋向照亮空气的阳光本身；远山发淡发白是同一回事（空气透视）。
desc.en: Looking at the horizon the line of sight is long, so blue scattered in is scattered out again and the colour tends to that of the sunlight itself; distant hills fade the same way (aerial perspective).

zh: 天空为什么越靠近地平线越淡
en: why is the sky white near the horizon
why do distant mountains look blue

title.zh: 米氏散射：云为什么是白的
title.en: Mie scattering: why clouds are white

desc.zh: 颗粒比光波大得多时（云滴约 4–17 微米），各种颜色被散射得差不多一样多；和光波差不多大时，散射起伏，甚至偏爱红光，让太阳发蓝。
desc.en: Once particles are far larger than the wavelength (cloud drops are about 4–17 µm), all colours scatter about equally; near the wavelength the scattering oscillates and can even favour red, turning the sun blue.

title.zh: 火星的天空：黄褐的白天、蓝色的日落
title.en: The Martian sky: butterscotch by day, blue at sunset

desc.zh: 火星空气太稀（440 纳米的瑞利光学厚度约 0.01），天空颜色由微米级、吸收蓝光的尘埃决定；尘埃把蓝光向前散射，日落时太阳附近发蓝。
desc.en: The Martian air is too thin (Rayleigh optical depth about 0.01 at 440 nm), so micron-sized dust that absorbs blue sets the sky colour; the dust scatters blue forward, so the sky near the setting sun is blue.

zh: 火星的天空是什么颜色
火星日落为什么是蓝的
en: what colour is the sky on Mars
why is the sunset blue on Mars
why is a dust storm sky yellow

title.zh: 多次散射与臭氧：简单模型漏掉的
title.en: Multiple scattering and ozone: what the simple model misses

desc.zh: 天顶约四分之一的蓝光被拐过不止一次；黄昏时天顶仍然是蓝的，主要靠臭氧 Chappuis 带的吸收（太阳在地平线时约占 66%）。
desc.en: About a quarter of the blue zenith light has been scattered more than once; the zenith stays blue at twilight mainly because of ozone's Chappuis-band absorption (about 66% with the sun at the horizon).

zh: 黄昏的天为什么是蓝的
en: why is the twilight sky blue
